verdicts.quote:
"I don't know," Marro said.

It was true. He was surprised how little that helped.
verdicts.reason: Hesse is never told, but the narration says it is true that Marro doesn't know why a Maegyr would host Rickard, which contradicts his knowing that Rickard's mother was a Maegyr daughter.

verdicts.quote: His mother had taught him letters on the backs of tally sheets, and he read it the way she'd made him, slowly, every word.
verdicts.reason: Marro reads the seating card himself and the narration credits his mother's teaching, which matches the ruling.
